maniacmod.intro.tip.1: Hold Shift + Right Mouse to repair a generator. Progress is kept if you let go, but it stalls while you are away.
maniacmod.intro.tip.2: Several survivors can repair one generator at once — their contributions add up.
maniacmod.intro.tip.3: A repaired generator still needs fuel: two canisters per generator.
maniacmod.intro.tip.4: Press 5 to see generators through walls. Only you see the outline. 30 second cooldown.
maniacmod.intro.tip.5: Your heart beats faster when the maniac is near. It is your only radar — listen to it.
maniacmod.intro.tip.6: Failing the repair mini-game blows the generator up and shows everyone where the noise is — the maniac too.
maniacmod.intro.tip.7: Falling 6 blocks or more can break your leg. Without a Splint your stamina will not recover.
maniacmod.intro.tip.8: A downed ally is revived by holding Right Mouse for about 8 seconds. They only have a minute.
maniacmod.intro.tip.9: The crowbar and the bat stun the maniac. The crowbar also frees you from a bear trap. Three uses.
maniacmod.intro.tip.10: Tripwires and ropes can be cut with scissors.
maniacmod.intro.tip.11: Adrenaline instantly restores stamina and grants Speed II.
maniacmod.intro.tip.12: The flashlight helps you see in the dark zones of the map.
maniacmod.intro.tip.13: The screwdriver speeds up generator repair.
maniacmod.intro.tip.14: Survivors cannot hurt each other — only the maniac deals damage.
maniacmod.intro.tip.15: Maniac: traps are Z, X, C; abilities are 1, 2, 3. A trap cannot be placed within 3 blocks of a player.

maniacmod.wiki.item.medkit.desc: A field medkit with bandages. Instantly restores some health while the maniac is somewhere close.
maniacmod.wiki.item.medkit.use: Hold it and press RMB. A short bandaging animation plays — better to hide for its duration.
maniacmod.wiki.item.medkit.tip: It is not spent if your health is already full.
maniacmod.wiki.item.splint.desc: A rigid splint for a broken leg. While the leg is broken, stamina stays at zero — you cannot run.
maniacmod.wiki.item.splint.use: Hold it and press RMB while your leg is broken. It does nothing on a healthy leg or while downed.
maniacmod.wiki.item.splint.tip: Legs break after a fall — save the splint for exactly that.
maniacmod.wiki.item.fuel_canister.desc: A fuel canister for a generator that ran dry. The charge is stored in the canister itself and it never disappears.
maniacmod.wiki.item.fuel_canister.use: Hold it, aim at a generator and hold Shift + RMB. Every percent added to the generator is taken out of the canister.
maniacmod.wiki.item.fuel_canister.tip: A half-used canister is not lost — top up another generator with it.
maniacmod.wiki.item.crowbar.desc: A heavy crowbar. Hit a trap with it to free a caught ally; in a pinch, it also stuns the maniac.
maniacmod.wiki.item.crowbar.use: Hold it and hit with LMB: a trap holding an ally to free them, or the maniac to stun them.
maniacmod.wiki.item.crowbar.tip: Durability is shown as a percentage on the icon — a broken crowbar saves no one.
maniacmod.wiki.item.bat.desc: A plain baseball bat. It will not free anyone from a trap, but stuns the maniac for longer than the crowbar.
maniacmod.wiki.item.bat.use: Hold it and hit the maniac with LMB. The bat does not work on traps.
maniacmod.wiki.item.bat.tip: Two good hits and the bat breaks. Make them count.
maniacmod.wiki.item.flashlight.desc: The lantern lights your way and helps you see in the dark zones of the map. It works while you hold it.
maniacmod.wiki.item.flashlight.use: Just hold it — there is nothing to click. Put it away and the light goes out.
maniacmod.wiki.item.flashlight.tip: The light can be seen from afar — in the open, hold it only when you really need it.
maniacmod.wiki.item.geo_scissors.desc: Sharp shears for fine work: they cut the maniac's electric wire and free an ally hanging on a rope.
maniacmod.wiki.item.geo_scissors.use: Hold them, aim at a wire or a hanging ally and press RMB. A hanging player can cut themselves down too.
maniacmod.wiki.item.geo_scissors.tip: A block in your line of sight hides the wire — stand where you can see it clearly.
maniacmod.wiki.item.screwdriver.desc: A handy screwdriver that doubles generator repair speed. It works passively — just keep it in your main hand.
maniacmod.wiki.item.screwdriver.use: Hold it in the main hand and repair the generator as usual (Shift + RMB). The bonus applies to the repair stage only.
maniacmod.wiki.item.screwdriver.fact.3: A full one lasts|≈ 20 s of work
maniacmod.wiki.item.screwdriver.tip: Holding it does not wear it down — durability goes only for real work.
maniacmod.wiki.item.adrenaline.desc: An adrenaline shot: a short burst of speed with no fatigue. The price is a hard crash when it wears off.
maniacmod.wiki.item.adrenaline.use: Hold it and press RMB. You cannot use it again while the effect or the crash lasts.
maniacmod.wiki.item.adrenaline.fact.1: Effect|10 s, Speed II, stamina is not spent
maniacmod.wiki.item.adrenaline.tip: Use it when the run to safety is already in sight, not beforehand.
maniacmod.wiki.item.signal_flare.desc: Shows the pilot where to land. Without it the helicopter won't come to the clearing.
maniacmod.wiki.item.signal_flare.use: Call the helicopter at the receiver first. Then stand in the clearing, on the ground, and RMB.
maniacmod.wiki.item.signal_flare.tip: A failed launch (wrong place, helicopter not called yet) doesn't use up the flare.
maniacmod.trapchoose.random.desc: Let fate choose: a random set from all available traps, exactly as many as allowed. Press again to reroll, then confirm or adjust by hand.
maniacmod.trapchoose.random.hint: Tip: the R key does the same as the button.

maniacmod.evac.dispatcher.name: Dispatcher
maniacmod.evac.dispatcher.call.1: Copy that, I hear you! The receiver is live, the helicopter is airborne.
maniacmod.evac.dispatcher.call.2: But we can't see you in this darkness. Get to the clearing and give us a mark — fire the signal flare.
maniacmod.evac.dispatcher.call.3: Stay together and don't waste time. We'll be right there. Over and out.

maniacmod.barricade.game.help.title: How to dismantle a barricade
maniacmod.barricade.game.help.demo_capti: Top to bottom, nail by nail.
maniacmod.barricade.game.help.step1: Hover a nail — it lights up.
maniacmod.barricade.game.help.step2: Hold LMB, RMB or Space: the crowbar pulls the nail with a screech.
maniacmod.barricade.game.help.step3: Both nails out — the board falls. There are twice as many nails as boards.
maniacmod.barricade.game.help.step4: A nail under another board is covered — remove the top board first.
maniacmod.barricade.game.help.step5: Let go and the nail sinks back. Fear speeds you up, and the maniac hears the screech!
